scope: Read-only independent integration review. Existing tests/results inspected, no new build or native UI run; prior decoder is reviewer-authored and is not independently certified here.

findings.detail: Pending completion tests only Project equality and root equality. No generation invalidation or visible-preview clearing on document/edit lifecycle; equal-value reopen or edit-and-undo can let a stale request publish. Parent is implementing generation-bound completion, cleanup and errors plus lifecycle invalidation.

reviewed_boundaries: Portable revision and token binding; fresh inspection supersedes prior token
Raw-byte Base64 paging, exact offsets, immutable full-report hash
Encoded report greater than 8388608 bytes refused without partial publication
Continuation manifest/source/replayed historical-report checks, failure revocation
Read-only project, dirty history and selection behavior
Mac read-only presentation and full JSON availability
scope_notes: Mac call currently passes no expected saved manifest digest; it captures same-ID saved manifest at inspection time.
Historical import report is replay-validated but its exact raw bytes/hash are not part of snapshot identity. A valid reserialization does not itself revoke the review.
